# KidsCove — Design Notes

## Source
- ColorLib: Kindergarten (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/kindergarten/)
- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/kindergarten/

## Section order
1. Navbar (logo, nav links, "Enroll Now" CTA)
2. Hero Slider ("Quality Learning", "Explore Classes" button)
3. About ("Welcome to our KidsCove" + 3 features + image)
4. Classes (4 class cards, dark bg, "More Classes")
5. Drawing Event (dark bg, "View Event")
6. Teachers (circular avatars, names)
7. Testimonials (carousel, dark bg)
8. Footer (Quick Links, About Us, social, Component Dock)

## Tokens
- Primary: #ED078B (hot pink) | Secondary: #1f2b7b (navy)
- Accent: #12D9DF (cyan) | Purple: #423F8D
- Fonts: Concert One + Fredoka One (display), DM Sans (body)
- Buttons: 30px radius | Avatars: 50%
